en: The image displays a classic black-and-white street view of an old European city. The architecture is distinctly late 19th or early 20th century, with ornate facades and large windows. People are seen walking along a cobblestone street lined with shops. Prominently visible is a shop with the name 'Hava'. The postcard has both Polish and German text, suggesting a region with historical ties to both languages.
